NEOW.talk.PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA.0-0r.anci: An unfamiliar melody... Did you hear the Spire calling, too?
NEOW.talk.PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA.0-1r.char: I will find where this melody leads.
NEOW.talk.PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA.0-2r.anci: Then take my gift, and keep going.
Another traveler reaches the end. What echo will you leave behind?
Let me play the final note of this journey.
Then let the Spire remember your melody.
